scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Functionality
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with headline, value proposition, and primary CTAs that navigate to registration and login pages

steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL path '/'
steps.context: User arrives at the application's main entry point

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains a bold headline, supporting subheadline, and call-to-action buttons
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Click the 'Get Started Free' button and verify navigation to the registration page
steps.context: Primary CTA should direct users to /register

steps.description: Click the 'Sign In' button and verify navigation to the login page
steps.context: Secondary CTA should direct users to /login

test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with headline containing value proposition text (e.g., 'Shorten Links' or similar)
H1 element exists with compelling headline text communicating core value
Subheadline text exists with key benefit statement
Navigation to '/register' route occurs
Navigation to '/login' route occurs

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases core product features with visual elements including icons, titles, and descriptions

steps.description: Navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features section should be below the hero section

steps.description: Check that 3-4 feature cards are displayed with icons, titles, and descriptions
steps.context: Features should highlight URL shortening, analytics, link management, and security

steps.description: Ensure each feature card contains appropriate content matching the product capabilities
steps.context: Content should accurately represent the URL shortening service features

test_cases.input: Render Homepage component and query features section
test_cases.expected: Features section container exists with proper section heading
At least 3 feature card elements are rendered
Feature card with title related to 'URL shortening' or 'Short links' exists with icon and description
Feature card with title related to 'Analytics' or 'Click tracking' exists with icon and description
Feature card with title related to 'Link management' or 'Dashboard' exists with icon and description

scenarios.name: How It Works Section
scenarios.description: Verify the 'How It Works' section displays a step-by-step visual guide explaining the user journey

steps.description: Find the section explaining the user journey on the homepage
steps.context: Section should provide clear steps for using the service

steps.description: Check that steps are displayed in logical order: Create account → Paste URL → Share link → Track performance
steps.context: Each step should have an icon or illustration and description

test_cases.input: Render Homepage and query for 'How It Works' section
test_cases.expected: Section with heading 'How It Works' or similar exists

test_cases.input: Query step elements in How It Works section
test_cases.expected: At least 3-4 step elements are rendered with step numbers or icons

test_cases.input: Check step content includes account creation
test_cases.expected: First step mentions creating an account or signing up

test_cases.input: Check step content includes URL pasting
test_cases.expected: Step exists mentioning pasting or entering a long URL
Step exists mentioning sharing the shortened link
Step exists mentioning tracking performance or analytics

steps.context: Links should navigate to respective pages

steps.description: Ensure copyright information is displayed

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Semantic HTML and ARIA
scenarios.description: Verify proper heading hierarchy, alt text, and ARIA attributes for screen reader compatibility

steps.description: Verify proper use of h1, h2, h3 tags in logical order

steps.description: Verify all images have appropriate alt attributes
steps.context: Alt text should describe image content

steps.description: Verify interactive elements have appropriate ARIA labels where needed
steps.context: Screen readers should be able to understand all elements

test_cases.input: Query all h1 elements on homepage
test_cases.expected: Exactly one h1 element exists on the page
Headings follow proper hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3) without skipping levels

test_cases.input: Query all img elements for alt attribute
test_cases.expected: All img elements have non-empty alt attributes
Buttons with only icons have aria-label attributes
Page has main element or role='main' for primary content

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Color Contrast
scenarios.description: Verify sufficient color contrast ratios for text readability (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance)

steps.description: Verify body text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio
steps.context: WCAG AA requirement for normal text

steps.description: Verify large text (18px+) meets 3:1 contrast ratio
steps.context: WCAG AA requirement for large text

steps.description: Verify buttons and links have sufficient contrast
steps.context: Interactive elements need to be visually distinguishable

test_cases.expected: Headline text meets minimum 3:1 contrast ratio against background
Body text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
Button text meets contrast requirements against button background
